mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter (story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{stageId}, #{planId}, #{chapterNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{generationStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, created_at, updated_at FROM chapter WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, created_at, updated_at FROM chapter WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
SELECT id, story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, created_at, updated_at FROM chapter WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY chapter_number ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, created_at, updated_at FROM chapter WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY chapter_number ASC, id ASC
